﴿كُونُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperative verb [of kāna and its sisters]; the wāw is its noun and its khabar (predicate) is ﴿قِرَدَةً﴾, and ﴿خاسِئِينَ﴾ is a second khabar — it is also said to be a naʿt (adjective). The clause كونوا قردة is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:66-67.t:
﴿فَجَعَلْناها﴾: [i.e.] the punishment just mentioned. ﴿نَكالًا﴾: an exemplary lesson. ﴿لِما بَيْنَ يَدَيْها﴾: for those who lived through it. ﴿ما خَلْفَها﴾: the nations who came after it.
﴿فَجَعَلْناها﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause is conjoined. ﴿نَكالًا﴾: second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِما﴾: ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the lām; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) نكال, or to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of it. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿يَدَيْها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a dual; the nūn was dropped because of the annexation, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما is conjoined to the first ما. ﴿خَلْفَها﴾: an adverb of place attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿وَمَوْعِظَةً﴾: conjoined to نكالا. ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾: both attached to موعظة, or to an omitted naʿt of it. ﴿وَإِذْ قالَ مُوسى لِقَوْمِهِ﴾: the i'rab of something like it has preceded. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿يَأْمُرُكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "هو" (He), referring back to Allah. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. «[Translator's note: the source prints this particle as ﴿إِنَّ﴾; the particle in the verse is أَنْ.]» ﴿تَذْبَحُوا﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by a preposition, its implied form being "بذبح بقرة" (to slaughter a cow), both attached to the verb before them. The clause يأمركم is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿بَقَرَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَتَتَّخِذُنا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation. تتخذنا is an imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "أنت" (you). ﴿هُزُواً﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَعُوذُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "أنا" (I). ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ; both are attached to أعوذ; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a maṣdar-forming and subjunctive particle. «[Translator's note: here too the source prints ﴿إِنَّ﴾ for the verse's أَنْ.]» ﴿أَكُونَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb [one of kāna and its sisters], subjunctive (manṣūb); it is, by interpretation, a maṣdar in the position of genitive by a preposition, the implied form being "من الجهل" (from ignorance), and both are attached to the verb أعوذ. The noun of أكون is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "أنا". ﴿مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾: both attached to the khabar of أكون.

daas-irab:68-69.t:
﴿الفارض﴾: the old, aged one. ﴿البكر﴾: the young one. ﴿العوان﴾: the middle-aged one.
﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ادْعُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "أنت" (you); the clause is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَنا﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ادع. ﴿رَبَّكَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُبَيِّنْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to a command (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil is "هو" (He), referring back to ربك. The clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the command. ﴿لَنا﴾: both attached to يبين. ﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هِيَ﴾: a detached nominative pronoun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb يبين. ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾: إنّ and its noun; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿يَقُولُ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "هو", referring back to Allah; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿إِنَّها﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿بَقَرَةٌ﴾: its khabar; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لا فارِضٌ﴾: لا is negative; فارض is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, the implied form being "لا هي فارض" (she is not old); the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective), and likewise ﴿وَلا بِكْرٌ﴾, the clause being conjoined. ﴿فارِضٌ﴾ may also be parsed as a naʿt. ﴿عَوانٌ﴾: khabar or naʿt.
﴿بَيْنَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to عنوان. «[Translator's note: so in the source (عنوان); the word meant is عوان.]» ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَافْعَلُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that reveals an omitted condition), i.e. "إذا وجدتم البقرة المطلوبة فافعلوا" (when you have found the required cow, then do). افعلوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition: "إذا وجدتم فافعلوا" (when you have found, then do). ﴿ما تُؤْمَرُونَ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; تؤمرون is a passive imperfect verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted: "ما تؤمرون به" (what you are commanded with). ﴿قالُوا ادْعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنْ لَنا ما لَوْنُها قالَ إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ إِنَّها بَقَرَةٌ﴾: see the previous verse.
﴿صَفْراءُ﴾: a naʿt of بقرة. ﴿فاقِعٌ﴾: a fronted khabar. ﴿لَوْنُها﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ, and the fāʿil of the adjective resembling the participle (ṣifa mushabbaha) فاقع is a pronoun latent (mustatir) in it. فاقع may also be parsed as a naʿt of بقرة, with لونها as the fāʿil of فاقع. The nominal clause is also a naʿt of بقرة.
﴿تَسُرُّ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿النَّاظِرِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ. The clause is a third naʿt of بقرة.

daas-irab:70-71.t:
﴿الأصفر الفاقع﴾: intensely yellow. ﴿لا ذَلُولٌ﴾: not broken in by work. ﴿تُثِيرُ الْأَرْضَ﴾: ploughs it. ﴿مُسَلَّمَةٌ﴾: free of defects. ﴿لا شِيَةَ﴾: no other colour together with her yellow colour.
﴿قالُوا ادْعُ لَنا رَبَّكَ يُبَيِّنْ لَنا ما هِيَ﴾: see verse 68. ﴿إِنَّ الْبَقَرَ﴾: إنّ and its noun. ﴿تَشابَهَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "هو" (it); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. The clause إن البقر is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb تشابه.
﴿وَإِنَّا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. إنا is إنّ and its noun. ﴿إِنَّ﴾: a jussive conditional particle making two verbs jussive. «[Translator's note: the source prints this particle as ﴿إِنَّ﴾; the conditional particle in the verse is إِنْ.]» ﴿شاءَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿لَمُهْتَدُونَ﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); مهتدون is the khabar of إنا. The clause وإنا لمهتدون is conjoined. The clause إن شاء الله is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being "إن شاء الله اهتدينا" (if Allah wills, we shall be guided). ﴿قالَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is "هو" (he). ﴿إِنَّهُ يَقُولُ﴾: إنّ and its noun; يقول is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is its khabar. The nominal clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّها بَقَرَةٌ﴾: إنّ, its noun and its khabar; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لا ذَلُولٌ﴾: لا is negative; ذلول is a naʿt (adjective) of بقرة, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject): "لا هي ذلول" (she is not broken in). ﴿تُثِيرُ الْأَرْضَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun.
The clause is likewise a naʿt of بقرة. ﴿وَلا تَسْقِي الْحَرْثَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the clause is conjoined to the preceding one, and لا is redundant (zāʾida).
﴿مُسَلَّمَةٌ﴾: a naʿt of بقرة. ﴿لا شِيَةَ﴾: لا is the lā of generic negation, working like إنّ; شية is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative. ﴿فِيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar. The clause is in the position of nominative as a fourth naʿt. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿الْآنَ﴾: mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time attached to the verb before them; it is also said to be attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial): "جئت متلبسا بالحق" (you have come bearing the truth). «[Translator's note: so in the source ("before them"); the verb جئت actually follows الآن.]» ﴿جِئْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: both attached to جئت; the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿فَذَبَحُوها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ذبحوها is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to omitted clauses before it, the implied form being "فطلبوها فاشتروها فذبحوها" (so they sought her, bought her, and slaughtered her). ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ما is negative. ﴿كادُوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; the clause وما كادوا is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿يَفْعَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:213-213.t:
﴿كانَ النَّاسُ أُمَّةً﴾ كان, its noun (ism) and its khabar (predicate). ﴿واحِدَةً﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿فَبَعَثَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿بعث اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, i.e. "mankind was one community, then they differed, so Allah sent". ﴿النَّبِيِّينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿مُبَشِّرِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمُنْذِرِينَ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْزَلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أنزل is a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah. ﴿مَعَهُمُ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِيَحْكُمَ﴾ the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); يحكم is an imperfect verb, accusative by an أن concealed after the lām of causation; it and the verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb أنزل. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to يحكم. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿النَّاسُ﴾ with ḍamma; as muḍāf ilayhi it is ﴿النَّاسِ﴾.] ﴿فِيمَا﴾ ما is relative, and both are attached to يحكم. ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; ما is negating. ﴿اخْتَلَفَ﴾ a past verb.
﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to اختلف. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil. ﴿أُوتُوهُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because of its connection to the wāw of the group; the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), which is the first object, and the hāʾ is the second object. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ both attached to اختلف. ﴿ما جاءَتْهُمُ﴾ ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival); جاءتهم is a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and it is interpreted with the maṣdariyya ما as a maṣdar in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الْبَيِّناتُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بَغْياً﴾ mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣifa of بغيا. ﴿فَهَدَى اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil and الذين is the mafʿūl bihi; آمنوا is a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿لِمَا﴾ both attached to هدى. ﴿اخْتَلَفُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun ما. ﴿مِنَ الْحَقِّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl from ما. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ both attached to هدى. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَهْدِي﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", referring to Allah; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the relative noun is ﴿مَنْ﴾.] ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿إِلى صِراطٍ﴾ both attached to يهدي. ﴿مُسْتَقِيمٍ﴾ ṣifa.

daas-irab:214-214.t:
﴿أَمْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿حَسِبْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَدْخُلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn; it is interpreted with the maṣdariyya أن as an interpreted maṣdar standing in place of the two objects of حسبتم. ﴿الْجَنَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لمّا is a jussive-governing particle. ﴿يَأْتِكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the weak letter, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿مَثَلُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is circumstantial. ﴿خَلَوْا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil.
﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) خلوا. ﴿مَسَّتْهُمُ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the feminine and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْبَأْساءُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَالضَّرَّاءُ﴾ conjoined; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in خلوا. ﴿وَزُلْزِلُوا﴾ زلزلوا is a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَقُولَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to زلزلوا. ﴿الرَّسُولُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ conjoined to الرسول. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to آمنوا.
﴿مَتى﴾ an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of نصر.
﴿نَصْرُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿أَلا﴾ an opening particle (istiftāḥ). ﴿إِنَّ نَصْرَ اللَّهِ قَرِيبٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun (ism) and its khabar; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:215-215.t: ﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿ماذا﴾ ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and ذا is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate); the clause is a fronted mafʿūl bihi. It may also be regarded as one word and parsed as an interrogative noun, a fronted mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you); the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما أَنْفَقْتُمْ﴾ ما is a jussive-governing conditional, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and it may also be parsed as a relative noun; أنفقتم is a past verb and the tāʾ is the fāʿil, and it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ما. ﴿فَلِلْوالِدَيْنِ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); للوالدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "then it is given to the parents". The clause ﴿أَنْفَقْتُمْ﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying), and the implied clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ conjoined to الوالدين. ﴿وَما تَفْعَلُوا مِنْ خَيْرٍ﴾ like ما أنفقتم من خير; the clause is conjoined or resumptive. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ بِهِ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism) and عليم its khabar; به is attached to عليم; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:216-216.t: ﴿كُتِبَ﴾ a passive past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) كتب. ﴿الْقِتالُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كُرْهٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to كره; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَعَسى﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); عسى is a non-inflecting (jāmid) past verb, and here it is complete (tāmm). ﴿أَنْ تَكْرَهُوا﴾ أن is a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative; تكرهوا is accusative by the deletion of the nūn, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of عسى. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ﴾ parsed like ﴿وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَكُمْ﴾. ﴿وَعَسى أَنْ تُحِبُّوا شَيْئاً وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَكُمْ﴾ the clause is conjoined to the one before it and is like it. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ is its khabar. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أنتم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ لا is negating; تعلمون is an imperfect verb and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of أنتم.

daas-irab:217-217.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنِ الشَّهْرِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسألونك. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿قِتالٍ﴾ badal (substitute) from الشهر. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to قتال. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you). ﴿قِتالٍ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). [Translator's note: the source prints this second ﴿قِتالٍ﴾ with kasra; as mubtadaʾ it is ﴿قِتالٌ﴾.] ﴿فِيهِ﴾ both attached to قتال also, or to a ṣifa of it. ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَصَدٌّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; صد is mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ﴾ both attached to صد; الله, the Name of Majesty, is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَكُفْرٌ﴾ conjoined to صد. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to كفر. ﴿وَالْمَسْجِدِ﴾ conjoined to سبيل. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ ṣifa. ﴿وَإِخْراجُ﴾ conjoined to صد. ﴿أَهْلِهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ both attached to إخراج. ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar of the mubtadaʾ صد. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to أكبر. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْفِتْنَةُ أَكْبَرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْقَتْلِ﴾ both attached to أكبر. ﴿وَلا يَزالُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا يزالون is an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and the wāw is its noun (ism). ﴿يُقاتِلُونَكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of لا يزالون. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَرُدُّوكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an أن concealed after حتى; the wāw is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi. The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿عَنْ دِينِكُمْ﴾ both attached to يردوكم. ﴿إِنِ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿اسْتَطاعُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, its implied form being: "that they turn you back". ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَرْتَدِدْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he), referring to مَن. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in يرتدد. ﴿عَنْ دِينِهِ﴾ both attached to يرتدد. ﴿فَيَمُتْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; يمت is a jussive imperfect verb, and the clause is conjoined to يرتدد. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هو is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿كافِرٌ﴾ its khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أولئك is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿حَبِطَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative.
﴿أَعْمالُهُمْ﴾ fāʿil; and the nominal clause ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of مَن. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ both attached to حبطت. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَأُولئِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَصْحابُ﴾ its khabar. ﴿النَّارِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿فِيها﴾ both attached to خالدون. ﴿خالِدُونَ﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:218-218.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ هاجَرُوا وَجاهَدُوا﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهدوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَرْجُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿رَحْمَتَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause ﴿أُولئِكَ يَرْجُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿غَفُورٌ﴾ first khabar. ﴿رَحِيمٌ﴾ second khabar.

daas-irab:219-219.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its object. ﴿عَنِ الْخَمْرِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسألونك. ﴿وَالْمَيْسِرِ﴾ conjoined to الخمر; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you). ﴿فِيهِما﴾ both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿إِثْمٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾ ṣifa (adjective); the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَمَنافِعُ﴾ conjoined to إثم. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of منافع. ﴿وَإِثْمُهُما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إثمهما is mubtadaʾ; the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the mīm and alif are two letters for the dual. ﴿أَكْبَرُ﴾ khabar. ﴿مِنْ نَفْعِهِما﴾ both attached to أكبر. ﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ ماذا يُنْفِقُونَ﴾ its i'rab has preceded with verse 214. [Translator's note: so in the source; the phrase is analysed under verse 215.]
﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta"; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْعَفْوَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "spend the surplus"; the omitted verbal clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿يُبَيِّنُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ both attached to يبين. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun (ism). ﴿تَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ.

daas-irab:220-220.t: ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتفكرون. ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْيَتامى قُلْ:﴾ conjoined to the first يسألونك and like it. ﴿إِصْلاحٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to إصلاح. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إن is conditional. ﴿تُخالِطُوهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَإِخْوانُكُمْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). إخوانكم is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "then they are your brothers"; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, and the clause ﴿إِنْ تُخالِطُوهُمْ﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah; the clause يعلم is the khabar. ﴿الْمُفْسِدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِ﴾ both attached to يعلم; the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ﴾ is resumptive. ﴿وَلَوْ شاءَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لو is conditional. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a verb and its fāʿil, and an omitted mafʿūl bihi, its implied form being "had He willed your hardship". ﴿لَأَعْنَتَكُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the apodosis of the condition لو; أعنتكم is a past verb, the fāʿil being "huwa", referring to Allah, and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun (ism) and its two khabars; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:221-221.t: ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَنْكِحُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْمُشْرِكاتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يُؤْمِنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the accusative by an أن concealed after حتى, and the interpreted maṣdar from it and the verb is in the position of the genitive by حتى; both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) تنكحوا. ﴿وَلَأَمَةٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive and the lām is for inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); أمة is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُؤْمِنَةٌ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ مُشْرِكَةٍ﴾ both attached to the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) خير. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is a conditional particle in the sense of إن. ﴿أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the fāʿil is "hiya" (she), referring to مشركة; the clause is circumstantial. [Translator's note: the source says the fāʿil is «هو» (masculine), although it refers to the feminine مشركة.] ﴿وَلا تَنْكِحُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿وَلا تُنْكِحُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ حَتَّى يُؤْمِنُوا وَلَعَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ مُشْرِكٍ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكُمْ﴾ parsed like what precedes it. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿إِلَى النَّارِ﴾ both attached to يدعون; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَدْعُوا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ﴾ the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَالْمَغْفِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الجنة. ﴿بِإِذْنِهِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of يدعو. ﴿وَيُبَيِّنُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يبين is an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لِلنَّاسِ﴾ both attached to يبين. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun (ism). ﴿يَتَذَكَّرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of لعلّ.

daas-irab:284-284.t:
﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause); the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَما فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: conjoined to ما في السموات. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إن is conditional. ﴿تُبْدُوا﴾: a jussive (majzūm) imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي أَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿أَوْ تُخْفُوهُ﴾: conjoined to ﴿تُبْدُوا﴾. ﴿يُحاسِبْكُمْ﴾: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحاسبكم. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿فَيَغْفِرُ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿يغفر﴾: a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb; the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "He forgives ...". ﴿لِمَنْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر; and the clause ﴿يَشاءُ ... ﴾
is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنْ يَشاءُ﴾: conjoined to يغفر لمن يشاء. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ﴾: the Name of Majesty is the mubtadaʾ and قدير is its khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar, and شيء is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive ...

daas-irab:285-285.t: ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمن. ﴿أُنْزِلَ﴾: a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "he". ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزل. ﴿وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: conjoined to الرسول; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿كُلٌّ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آمَنَ﴾: a past verb, and the fāʿil is the latent (mustatir) "he". ﴿بِاللَّهِ وَمَلائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to آمن, and what follows it is conjoined to it; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كل. ﴿لا نُفَرِّقُ﴾: لا is negating; نفرق is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is "we" (naḥnu). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb, attached to نفرق. ﴿أَحَدٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ رُسُلِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of أحد; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an omitted verb, and the omitted saying clause is in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَقالُوا سَمِعْنا وَأَطَعْنا﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾ is the object of the saying, and أطعنا is conjoined. ﴿غُفْرانَكَ﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), in construct, accusative. ﴿وَإِلَيْكَ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, the implied form being: "from You is the beginning and to You is the return".

daas-irab:286-286.t: ﴿لا يُكَلِّفُ﴾: لا is negating; يكلف is an imperfect verb. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). ﴿نَفْساً﴾: first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وُسْعَها﴾: second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun, postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; and likewise ﴿وَعَلَيْها مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ﴾; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed in the vocative (munādā), in construct. ﴿لا تُؤاخِذْنا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lā; نا is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is "you" (anta); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿إِنْ نَسِينا﴾: إن is a conditional particle that makes the verb jussive; نسينا is a past verb and نا is the fāʿil; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿أَوْ أَخْطَأْنا﴾: conjoined to نسينا. ﴿رَبَّنا﴾: the one addressed, with an omitted vocative particle. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and لا is prohibitive. ﴿تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنا إِصْراً﴾: a jussive imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحمل. ﴿كَما﴾: ما is the maṣdar-particle, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to تحمل. ﴿حَمَلْتَهُ﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; with ما it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the kāf, the two being attached to an omitted adjective of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿عَلَى الَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to حملته. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِنا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila. ﴿رَبَّنا وَلا تُحَمِّلْنا ما لا طاقَةَ لَنا بِهِ﴾: تحملنا is an imperfect verb, jussive by lā, and نا is mafʿūl bihi; ما is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi; لا is the lā of generic negation; طاقة is its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; لنا and به are both attached to the omitted khabar of lā. ﴿وَاعْفُ﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اعف. ﴿وَاغْفِرْ لَنا وَارْحَمْنا﴾: conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿أَنْتَ مَوْلانا﴾: أنت is a detached pronoun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ. ﴿مَوْلانا﴾: khabar, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَانْصُرْنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction or causal; انصرنا is a verb of supplication, and نا is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿عَلَى الْقَوْمِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انصرنا. ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:144-144.t:
﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿نَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with the implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil (agent) is "we". ﴿تَقَلُّبَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وَجْهِكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the kāf is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿فِي السَّماءِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar تقلب. ﴿فَلَنُوَلِّيَنَّكَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); نولينك is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil is "we" and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قِبْلَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the response to an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿تَرْضاها﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with the implied ḍamma; ها is mafʿūl bihi and the fāʿil is "you"; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of قبلة. ﴿فَوَلِّ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; ولّ is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿وَجْهِكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَطْرَ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of place attached to the verb ولّ. ﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ an adjective. The clause ول وجهك is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَحَيْثُ ما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; حيثما is a jussive conditional noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كنتم. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ kāna and its noun; it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَوَلُّوا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition; ولوا is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وُجُوهَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿شَطْرَهُ﴾ mafʿūl fīhi, an adverb of place attached to the verb before it; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; inna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as its noun. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb indeclinable on the ḍamma because of its connection with the wāw of the plural, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, the nāʾib fāʿil being the first object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); يعلمون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ anna and its noun. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ its khabar; anna with its noun and its khabar has stood in place of the two objects of يعلمون. ﴿مِنْ رَبِّهِمْ﴾ attached to an omitted element in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الحق. The clause ﴿لَيَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna. ﴿وَمَا﴾ the wāw is resumptive; mā is the Ḥijāzī negative mā that operates like laysa. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; غافل is the khabar of mā. ﴿عَمَّا﴾ ʿan and the relative mā; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to غافل. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:145-145.t: ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām paves the way for the response to the oath; in is a jussive conditional particle. ﴿أَتَيْتَ﴾ a past verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because of its connection with the tāʾ of the agent; it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause ﴿أُوتُوا الْكِتابَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿أُوتُوا﴾ a passive past verb, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), being the first object; الكتاب is the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿آيَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿ما تَبِعُوا﴾ mā is negative; تبعوا is a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿قِبْلَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the kāf is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa; the clause is the response to the oath, and it has made the apodosis of the condition unnecessary. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; mā operates like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ its noun. ﴿بِتابِعٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; تابع is a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar (predicate) of mā. ﴿قِبْلَتَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi of تابع; the clause is conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿وَما بَعْضُهُمْ بِتابِعٍ قِبْلَةَ بَعْضٍ﴾ the clause is conjoined to what precedes it and is parsed in the same way. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; the lām paves the way for the response to the oath; in is conditional. ﴿اتَّبَعْتَ﴾ a past verb, and its fāʿil is the tāʾ. ﴿أَهْواءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿جاءَكَ﴾ a past verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾ attached to the verb. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of answer and requital (jawāb wa-jazāʾ). ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). ﴿من الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of inna. The clause إنك is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:146-146.t:
﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿آتَيْناهُمُ﴾ a past verb indeclinable on the sukūn; نا is the fāʿil (agent) and the hāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of آتيناهم.
﴿يَعْرِفُونَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition; mā is maṣdariyya. ﴿يَعْرِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَبْناءَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. The maṣdariyya mā with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of an omitted maṣdar, the implied form being: "they know with a witnessed knowledge like their knowledge of their sons". ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; inna is a particle resembling the verb (ḥarf mushabbah bi-l-fiʿl). ﴿فَرِيقاً﴾ its noun.
﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ attached to فريقا. ﴿لَيَكْتُمُونَ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); يكتمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. The nominal clause ﴿وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:147-148.t:
﴿الْحَقُّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; lā is prohibitive. ﴿تَكُونَنَّ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm) by the lā of prohibition; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun implied as "you". ﴿مِنَ الْمُمْتَرِينَ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar of تكون.
[Translator's note: from here to the end of the entry the source's Quranic-word markers are damaged (the opening brackets and first letters are lost); the words are restored below from the Quranic text.]
﴿وَلِكُلٍّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; لكل is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted fronted khabar. ﴿وِجْهَةٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُوَلِّيها﴾ the khabar of هو, nominative with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa; the nominal clause هو موليها is in the position of nominative as an adjective of وجهة. ﴿فَاسْتَبِقُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa. استبقوا: an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْخَيْراتِ﴾ accusative by removal of the preposition; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿أَيْنَ ما﴾ a jussive conditional noun indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as an adverb of place, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of تكونوا. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective imperfect verb, jussive by dropping the nūn; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw is its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; it is the apodosis of the condition.
﴿بِكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يأت. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition not joined by the fāʾ or the idhā of surprise. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدير. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ the khabar of inna; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:149-149.t:
﴿وَمِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; min is a preposition. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ولّ after them. ﴿خَرَجْتَ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa.
﴿فَوَلِّ﴾ the fāʾ is a linking one, because of the sense of condition in ḥaythu; ولّ is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the weak letter, and the fāʿil is "you".
﴿وَجْهَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿شَطْرَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to ول. ﴿الْمَسْجِدِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial; إنه is inna and its noun. ﴿لَلْحَقُّ﴾ the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); الحق is its khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ رَبِّكَ﴾ attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of الحق; the clause is circumstantial. ﴿وَمَا اللَّهُ بِغافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ its i'rab preceded with verse 74.

daas-irab:150-150.t: ﴿وَمِنْ حَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ فَوَلِّ وَجْهَكَ شَطْرَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرامِ وَحَيْثُ ما كُنْتُمْ فَوَلُّوا وُجُوهَكُمْ شَطْرَهُ﴾ its i'rab has preceded in the previous verse, and the i'rab of ﴿وَحَيْثُ ما كُنْتُمْ﴾ preceded in verse 144. ﴿لِئَلَّا﴾ the lām is a preposition; an is a subjunctive particle assimilated into the negative lā. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb); the interpreted maṣdar from the subjunctive an and the verb is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably the omitted element to which لئلا is attached is meant, while the khabar of يكون is mentioned next.] ﴿لِلنَّاسِ عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿حُجَّةٌ﴾ the postponed noun of يكون. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa in the position of accusative as the excepted. ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa, and lā is the jussive lā of prohibition. ﴿تَخْشَوْهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَاخْشَوْنِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اخشوني is an imperative verb indeclinable on dropping the nūn because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلِأُتِمَّ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl); أتم is an imperfect verb, subjunctive by an implied an after it; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to لئلا يكون. ﴿نِعْمَتِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتم. ﴿وَلَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; laʿalla and its noun. ﴿تَهْتَدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is its khabar. The nominal clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:151-151.t:
﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition; mā is maṣdariyya. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فِيكُمْ﴾ attached to أرسلنا. ﴿رَسُولًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ attached to the verb before them. ﴿يَتْلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ attached to يتلوا. ﴿آياتِنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of رسول.
﴿وَيُزَكِّيكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; and likewise ﴿وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ﴾; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿وَيُعَلِّمُكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the kāf is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لَمْ تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as khabar (predicate), and the clause لم تكونوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:72-73.t:
﴿ادارأتم﴾: its original form is تدارأتم: you pushed [the blame] onto one another and disputed about it. ﴿اضْرِبُوهُ بِبَعْضِها﴾:
strike the slain man with some of her flesh; so they struck him and Allah brought him to life, and He followed this with His saying "كذلك يحيي الله الموتى" (thus Allah gives life to the dead).
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the i'rab of إذ has preceded. ﴿قَتَلْتُمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿نَفْساً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَادَّارَأْتُمْ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause is conjoined to قتلتم. ﴿فِيها﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ادارأتم.
﴿وَاللَّهُ مُخْرِجٌ﴾: the wāw is the wāw of parenthesis (iʿtirāḍ). الله, the Name of Majesty, is mubtadaʾ (subject) and مخرج is the khabar (predicate); the clause is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa). ﴿ما كُنْتُمْ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi of the active participle مخرج; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters], the tāʾ is its noun, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿تَكْتُمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿فَقُلْنا﴾:
the clause is conjoined. ﴿اضْرِبُوهُ﴾:
an imperative verb; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِبَعْضِها﴾:
both attached to the verb before them. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾:
the kāf is a preposition; ذلك is a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the preposition; the lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the implied form being "كذلك يحيي الله الموتى إحياء مثل ذلك الإحياء" (thus Allah gives life to the dead, a giving of life like that giving of life). ﴿يُحْيِ﴾:
an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ because of heaviness. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾:
the Name of Majesty, fāʿil. ﴿الْمَوْتى﴾:
mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), because before it there is omitted speech, as if Allah the Exalted had said: "فضربوه ببعضها فيحيى، كذلك يحيي" (so they struck him with part of it and he came to life; thus He gives life). ﴿وَيُرِيكُمْ﴾:
the wāw is a conjunction; an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿آياتِهِ﴾:
second mafʿūl bihi, accusative with kasra. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾:
لعل and its noun, and the clause ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾
is its khabar.

daas-irab:74-74.t:
﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿قَسَتْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif, which was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾: fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) قست. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَهِيَ﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; هي is a detached nominative pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَالْحِجارَةِ﴾: both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); it is also said that the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل) and is itself the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَوْ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿أَشَدُّ﴾: khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هي أشد" (they are harder); [or] conjoined to the kāf or to the omitted khabar, as a conjoining of single words. ﴿قَسْوَةً﴾: tamyīz (specification).
﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of inna and its sisters). ﴿مِنَ الْحِجارَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of إنّ.
﴿لَما﴾: the lām is the lām of initiation (lām al-ibtidāʾ) — it is also said to be the shifted lām (muzaḥlaqa); ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as the delayed noun of إنّ. ﴿يَتَفَجَّرُ﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: both attached to يتفجر. ﴿الْأَنْهارُ﴾: fāʿil. The clause ﴿إِنَّ مِنَ الْحِجارَةِ﴾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَإِنَّ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إنّ is a particle resembling the verb. ﴿مِنْها﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿لَما﴾: the lām is the lām of initiation; ما is a relative noun, its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَشَّقَّقُ﴾ is an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ الْماءُ﴾ is conjoined to it, and likewise the clause ﴿وَإِنَّ مِنْها لَما يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ﴾. ﴿وَمَا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; ما is negative, working like ليس. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. «[Translator's note: the source prints the word with a kasra (﴿اللَّهِ﴾) although it parses it as the noun of ما (nominative); in the verse it is اللَّهُ.]» ﴿بِغافِلٍ﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; غافل is a noun, genitive in form and accusative in position, as the khabar of ما. ﴿عَمَّا﴾: عن is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the active participle غافل. ﴿تَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, and the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, its implied form being "عما تعملونه" (of what you do).

daas-irab:75-75.t:
﴿أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ﴾: the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is a conjunction; تطمعون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنْ يُؤْمِنُوا﴾: the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the verb and the maṣdar-forming particle is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, the implied form being "في إيمانهم" (in their believing). It is also said to be in the position of accusative by removal of the preposition. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يؤمنوا. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realization (taḥqīq). ﴿كانَ﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb [one of kāna and its sisters]. ﴿فَرِيقٌ﴾: its noun. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: both attached to a naʿt (adjective) of فريق. ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿كَلامَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause كان فريق منهم is circumstantial. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾: a conjunction.
﴿يُحَرِّفُونَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾: [من بعد:] both attached to the verb. ﴿ما عَقَلُوهُ﴾: ما is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the verb after it as a maṣdar in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), the implied form being "بعد عقلهم له" (after their understanding it); the clause يحرفونه is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; هم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:76-76.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذا is an adverb for future time, putting its condition in the genitive [by annexation] and attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis. ﴿لَقُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position.
﴿آمَنَّا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and نا is the fāʿil; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِذا﴾: conjoined to the first إذا. ﴿خَلا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa. ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿إِلى بَعْضٍ﴾: both attached to the verb خلا. The clause is in the position of genitive by annexation. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil. The clause is the apodosis of إذا. ﴿أَتُحَدِّثُونَهُمْ﴾: the hamza is interrogative; تحدثونهم is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the clause is maqūl al-qawl. ﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition; ما is relative or maṣdariyya; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them, and the clause ﴿فَتَحَ اللَّهُ﴾ has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: both attached to فتح. ﴿لِيُحَاجُّوكُمْ﴾: the lām is the lām of outcome (lām al-ʿāqiba), or of result (al-ṣayrūra), and it is like the lām of causation (taʿlīl).
﴿يحاجوكم﴾: an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of outcome, the sign of its subjunctive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the kāf is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb تحدثونهم. ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to يحاجوكم. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place attached to the verb before it. ﴿رَبِّكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أَفَلا تَعْقِلُونَ﴾: its i'rab has preceded.

daas-irab:77-77.t: ﴿أَوَلا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation and rebuke, and the wāw is resumptive; لا is negative. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: أنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿يَعْلَمُ﴾: the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿ما يُسِرُّونَ﴾: ما is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause يسرون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause يعلمون is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause ﴿وَما يُعْلِنُونَ﴾ is conjoined. أنّ with its noun and its khabar takes the place of the two objects of يعلمون.

daas-irab:78-79.t:
﴿وَمِنْهُمْ﴾: the wāw is resumptive; منهم: both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿أُمِّيُّونَ﴾: a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative with the wāw. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: لا is negative; يعلمون is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of nominative as a naʿt (adjective). ﴿الْكِتابَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of exception. ﴿أَمانِيَّ﴾: excepted (mustathnā), accusative; the nominal clause ومنهم أميون is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَإِنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن has the meaning of the negative ما. ﴿هُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿يَظُنُّونَ﴾: the clause is the khabar of هم, and the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿فَوَيْلٌ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive; ويل is mubtadaʾ, nominative; beginning with it was permissible, though it is indefinite, because it is an imprecation. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: both attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive.
﴿يَكْتُبُونَ الْكِتابَ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِأَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a noun, genitive with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿ثُمَّ يَقُولُونَ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: both attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿لِيَشْتَرُوا﴾: the lām is the lām of causation (lām al-taʿlīl); يشتروا is an imperfect verb, subjunctive (manṣūb), and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾: both attached to the verb before them. ﴿ثَمَناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾: a naʿt, accusative. ﴿فَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ﴾: the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿مِمَّا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ ويل. ﴿كَتَبَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَوَيْلٌ لَهُمْ﴾: the clause is conjoined to the clause ويل preceding it. ﴿مِمَّا﴾: both attached to ويل.
﴿يَكْسِبُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila.

daas-irab:222-222.t:
﴿وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; يسألونك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, the fāʿil being "anta" (you); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَذىً﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the saying). ﴿فَاعْتَزِلُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); اعتزلوا is an imperative verb and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿النِّساءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي الْمَحِيضِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), its implied form being "being in the state of menstruation". ﴿وَلا تَقْرَبُوهُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿فَاعْتَزِلُوا﴾ has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and genitive. ﴿يَطْهُرْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them. ﴿فَإِذا﴾
the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) for future time, putting its condition in the genitive and itself made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿تَطَهَّرْنَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَأْتُوهُنَّ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); أتوهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the deletion of the nūn because its imperfect is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ من is a preposition; حيث is an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to أتوهن. ﴿أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the Name of Majesty as fāʿil. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). ﴿يُحِبُّ﴾ an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being "huwa" (He). ﴿التَّوَّابِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ; the clause is the khabar of إنّ, and likewise the clause ﴿وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ﴾, which is conjoined to it.

daas-irab:223-223.t: ﴿نِساؤُكُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿حَرْثٌ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ṣifa (adjective) of حرث; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأْتُوا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); أتوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿حَرْثَكُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَنَّى﴾ a conditional noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of time — it has also been said, of place — attached to أتوا. ﴿شِئْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَقَدِّمُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; قدموا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ﴾ both attached to قدموا. ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; these clauses are all conjoined. ﴿وَبَشِّرِ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil being "anta" (you); the clause is conjoined, and أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا. [Translator's note: the source does not parse ﴿أَنَّكُمْ مُلاقُوهُ﴾ separately; this last remark refers to it.]

daas-irab:224-224.t: ﴿وَلا تَجْعَلُوا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā; تجعلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿عُرْضَةً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لِأَيْمانِكُمْ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) عرضة; the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿تَبَرُّوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), the implied form being "for fear of your being righteous". ﴿وَتَتَّقُوا وَتُصْلِحُوا﴾ like تبروا. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to تصلحوا. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) and two khabars (predicates); the clause is resumptive or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya).

daas-irab:225-225.t: ﴿لا يُؤاخِذُكُمُ﴾ لا is negating; يؤاخذكم is an imperfect verb and the kāf is its object. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِاللَّغْوِ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤاخذكم. ﴿فِي أَيْمانِكُمْ﴾ both attached to اللغو, or to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿يُؤاخِذُكُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil being "huwa" (He), referring to Allah the Exalted; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِما﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿كَسَبَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور and حليم are two khabars (predicates).

daas-irab:226-226.t: ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿يُؤْلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنْ نِسائِهِمْ﴾ both attached to the verb before them. ﴿تَرَبُّصُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَرْبَعَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَشْهُرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿إن﴾ a jussive-governing conditional. ﴿فاؤُ﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ here; the Quranic text is ﴿فَإِنَّ﴾.] ﴿إن اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and the Name of Majesty as its noun (ism). ﴿غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ two khabars; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:227-227.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿عَزَمُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الطَّلاقَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); it has also been said that it is accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "upon divorce". The clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إنّ, the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism), and سميع and عليم are its two khabars (predicates); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
It has also been said that the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "let them carry it out".

daas-irab:228-228.t:
﴿وَالْمُطَلَّقاتُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); المطلقات is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يَتَرَبَّصْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِنَّ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتربصن. ﴿ثَلاثَةَ﴾ an adverb of time, attached to يتربصن; it has also been said that it is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قُرُوءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; لا is negating. ﴿يَحِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿لَهُنَّ﴾ both attached to يحل. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَكْتُمْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative by أن, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; أن and the imperfect verb are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of يحل. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلَقَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil. ﴿فِي أَرْحامِهِنَّ﴾ both attached to خلق; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿أَنْ﴾; the conditional particle in the Quranic text is ﴿إِنْ﴾. The same applies to the second ﴿أَنْ﴾ below.] ﴿كُنَّ﴾ an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because of its connection to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn is its noun (ism); it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿يُؤْمِنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنّ, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "if they believe, then let them not do so".
﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty is genitive by the bāʾ, and both are attached to يؤمنّ. ﴿وَالْيَوْمِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿الْآخِرِ﴾ ṣifa (adjective). ﴿وَبُعُولَتُهُنَّ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; بعولتهن is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَحَقُّ﴾ khabar. ﴿بِرَدِّهِنَّ﴾ both attached to أحق. ﴿فِي ذلِكَ﴾ both attached to ردهن. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿أَرادُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis. ﴿إِصْلاحاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَلَهُنَّ﴾ both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مِثْلُ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِالْمَعْرُوفِ﴾ both attached to an omitted ṣifa of مثل, or to the khabar; the nominal clause ﴿وَلَهُنَّ﴾ is conjoined to the one before it. ﴿وَلِلرِّجالِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; للرجال: both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar as well. ﴿دَرَجَةٌ﴾ postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and عزيز and حكيم are two khabars; the clause is resumptive or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya).

daas-irab:229-229.t:
﴿الطَّلاقُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مَرَّتانِ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) with the alif because it is dual. ﴿فَإِمْساكٌ﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); إمساك is the mubtadaʾ of an omitted khabar, its implied form being "then upon you is retaining". ﴿بِمَعْرُوفٍ﴾ both attached to (mutaʿalliq) إمساك. ﴿أَوْ تَسْرِيحٌ﴾ أو is a conjunction; تسريح is conjoined to إمساك. ﴿بِإِحْسانٍ﴾ both attached to تسريح. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); لا is negating. ﴿يَحِلُّ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ both attached to يحل. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿تَأْخُذُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by the deletion of the nūn; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of يحل, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ both attached to تأخذوا. ﴿آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is the tāʾ of the agent, the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the nūn is for the feminine plural; its ḍamma was prolonged, and so the wāw arose; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi of تأخذوا. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿يَخافا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by the deletion of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar (interpreted maṣdar) in the position of the genitive by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being: "except fearing". [Translator's note: no preposition appears in the text; one is implied.] ﴿إِلَّا﴾ أن is an accusative-governing particle and لا is negating. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِلَّا﴾; the word in the Quranic text is ﴿أَلَّا﴾ (أن + لا).] ﴿يُقِيما﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative; the verb with أن is interpreted as a maṣdar in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; إن is conditional. ﴿خِفْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; it is in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَلَّا يُقِيما﴾ the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of خفتم. ﴿حُدُودَ اللَّهِ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb); لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿جُناحَ﴾ its noun (ism), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa. ﴿عَلَيْهِما﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar of لا. ﴿فِيمَا﴾ both attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿افْتَدَتْ﴾ a past verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿بِهِ﴾ both attached to افتدت; the clause فلا جناح is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ khabar. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ with fatḥa; as khabar it is ﴿حُدُودُ﴾.] ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.
﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; لا is the prohibitive, jussive-governing lā. ﴿تَعْتَدُوها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَتَعَدَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the weak letter, the fāʿil being "huwa" (he). ﴿حُدُودَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis; أولئك is mubtadaʾ. ﴿هُمُ﴾ a second mubtadaʾ. ﴿الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ its khabar; the nominal clause ﴿هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause ﴿فَأُولئِكَ ... ﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
And the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of مَن.

daas-irab:152-152.t: ﴿فَاذْكُرُونِي﴾ the fāʾ is the faṣīḥa; اذكروني is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَذْكُرْكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the command (jawāb al-ṭalab); the fāʿil is "I" and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿وَاشْكُرُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; اشكروا is like the preceding اذكروا. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is the jussive lā of prohibition. ﴿تَكْفُرُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive by dropping the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection, and the omitted yāʾ is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:153-154.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ see verse no. 21. The clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿اسْتَعِينُوا﴾ an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِالصَّبْرِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. ﴿وَالصَّلاةِ﴾ conjoined to الصبر. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ inna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ maʿa is an adverb of place attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of inna; الصابرين is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَلا تَقُولُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lā is the jussive lā of prohibition; تقولوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by dropping the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ man is a relative noun in the position of genitive; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb before them; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يُقْتَلُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ attached to the verb before them; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿أَمْواتٌ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: "they are dead"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction. ﴿أَحْياءٌ﴾ the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: "they are alive"; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; lākin is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿لا تَشْعُرُونَ﴾ lā is negative; تشعرون is an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what precedes it.

daas-irab:155-157.t:
﴿وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the lām paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); نبلونكم is an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because of its connection with the heavy nūn of emphasis; the fāʿil (agent) is "we" and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِشَيْءٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) نبلونكم. ﴿مِنَ الْخَوْفِ﴾ attached to an omitted adjective of شيء. ﴿وَالْجُوعِ﴾ conjoined to الخوف. ﴿وَنَقْصٍ﴾ conjoined. ﴿مِنَ الْأَمْوالِ﴾ attached to an adjective of نقص. ﴿وَالْأَنْفُسِ وَالثَّمَراتِ﴾ also conjoined. ﴿وَبَشِّرِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; بشر is an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you". ﴿الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative with the yāʾ; the clause is conjoined to the clause لنبلونكم. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of accusative as an adjective of الصابرين. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb for future time, attached to its apodosis قالوا. ﴿أَصابَتْهُمْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿مُصِيبَةٌ﴾ fāʿil; the clause is in the position of genitive by iḍāfa. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to راجعون. [Translator's note: so in the source; لله is usually taken as the khabar of the first inna.] ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; inna and its noun. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ attached to راجعون; the clause is conjoined to the clause before it. ﴿راجِعُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative with the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural.
